definition: a room where art is shown to the public
description: A man carrying a leather briefcase walks through a doorway into a narrow white room hung with small framed drawings. He moves on into a larger white hall where other visitors stand in front of sculptures on plinths, and tips his head back to look up at a big block-coloured abstract canvas. The last shots put him alone in a vast glass-roofed hall, walking towards an enormous painting on the far wall and spreading his arms in front of it.

taps.phrase: to gaze up at a canvas

de.answer: Er betrachtet Gemälde in einer Galerie.
